main_text.l: fas effe operationes : fecundum quæ, quamuis
inter fe plurimum differentia , membra fingula
Ecclefiæ ita occupantur in iis muneribus quæ
præfcribit Deus , vt vnus & idem Spiritus om-
nia efficiat in omnibus pro demenso donatio-
nis Christi. Quapropter expendant Christiani,
quantopere indignum fit vocatione ipsorum &
honore quem Deus ipsis habere dignatus est in
filio dilectionis suæ , si aut membra corporis,
aut lapides domus , aut ciuitatis partes, quas
Deus adunat gratiosè , animo ingratissimo di-
uulserint atque disperserint : Et quia hoc tem-
pore Deus in colligendo sanctissimo illo cor-
pore,templo,& ciuitate operam suorum occu-
pat , quantopere ab iis alienum qui Christiani
audiunt , si membra quæ Deus aduocat deter-
ruerint,quę adducit depulerint,& in eos sint in-
iurij quibus gratiam facit Deus, aut spes often-
ditur facturum esse.
Quòd si hæc omnia vel hac vna ciuitatis ap-
pellatione nobis oftenduntur; quanto magis, si
ad modum ciuitatis illius venerimus,veritatem
istorum omnium sentiemus , & officium cha-
ritatis animaduertemus præstari à nobis opor-
tere? Nam Ecclesia non quoduis ædificium aut
vulgare appellatur, sed reipsa præstantissimum
(vt sequentibus verbis exponitur ) & dignitate
nulli in cœloaut terra postponendum.Hanc di-
gnitatem ( vt anté perstrinximus) duobus mo-
dis Propheta oftendit : quod est vt ciuitas coa-
gmentata

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "spes often-" in the first paragraph is printed "fpes often-" (the word "oftenditur" is cut at the line end; the printed text reads "fpes often-" followed by "ditur"); "stantissimum" line 19 may read "præstantissimum" as printed. Some words in the first column are set in an unusual font with a long s; the transcription normalises long s to s as required. Line 2 of the left column: "quæ" as printed. The first paragraph begins without indent after "spes often-ditur facturum esse." and the printed line "Quòd si" starts a new paragraph. The final line "gmentata" is a catchword-like fragment; it is the end of a word broken at the column foot and is recorded as the final text of the column. Hyphen-broken words are kept with printed hyphens. Possible printing error: "vt anté perstrinximus" as printed.
